selection: Five inspections of the same solution. The first requested 174 names, including all 155 route declarations, and found 171. The second added six declarations for comparison with compiled modules. The third requested 27 theta-related names and found 21, including one previously queried. The fourth scanned 62 candidate names and found 52 new declarations. Nine additional names were confirmed in the source and absent from the export. A namespace spelling candidate was excluded from the published source-name list. The fifth recovered all 27 additional branch names. The combined selection contains 276 distinct declarations and 18 confirmed source names absent from the export. Line numbers are one-based and byte offsets are zero-based in the unpacked solution. Three later inspections covered adelic lattice packing, transverse periods, arithmetic faces and the cohomological torsion comparison. The sixth requested 66 names and found 65. The seventh requested 42 and found 42. The eighth requested 9 and found 9. Across all eight inspections the combined selection contains 392 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The ninth inspection added all nine requested declarations for the degree shift in arithmetic face homology. The total is now 401 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The tenth inspection searched 77 new names for branching periods, local unfolding, compact-type compression and coefficient decay. It recovered 77 declarations. The combined total is 478 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The eleventh inspection searched 78 new names for unitary covolumes, parabolic shell measures, the mixed compact Casimir and shifted tensor moments. It recovered 77 declarations. The combined total is 555 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The twelfth inspection searched 47 new names for prescribed-discriminant lattice masses, exact unipotence from near traces, and previously identified private and slice-measure intermediates. It recovered 47 declarations. The combined total is 602 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The thirteenth inspection searched 48 new names for rational subspace orbits, the local genus of maximal Hermitian lattices, and derivatives of branching vectors. It recovered all 48 declarations. The combined total is 650 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The fourteenth inspection searched 28 new names for quantum cofactors, primitive discriminant gluings, and the orthonormal and derivative suppliers. It recovered all 28 declarations. The combined total is 678 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The fifteenth inspection searched 13 new names for short primitive lines, trace-lattice packing, and adjacent-column cancellation in a quantum minor. It recovered all 13 declarations. The combined total is 691 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The sixteenth inspection searched 24 new names for the branching walk, its large- and small-side lowering steps, and the occurrence model. It recovered all 24 declarations. The combined total is 715 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The seventeenth inspection searched 4 new names for the two coefficient-integral constructions of intertwiners and the stabilizer estimate in the global primitive mean. It recovered all 4 declarations. The combined total is 719 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The eighteenth inspection searched 8 new names for line projection labels and recovery of a hyperplane gluing from one lifted generator. It recovered all 8 declarations. The combined total is 727 distinct declarations with 19 confirmed source names absent from the export. The nineteenth inspection queried 48 new names for the dual tensor construction, regular parameter models, coefficient integrals, line mass and the hyperplane average. It recovered 47 declarations. One candidate belongs to a different namespace in the source and is excluded from the source-only list. The combined selection contains 774 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source-only names. The twentieth inspection queried 37 new names for the smaller-parameter lowering, derivative words, the distant trial vector and its spectral estimate. It recovered 37 declarations. The combined selection contains 811 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source-only names. The twenty-first inspection queried 29 new names for the signed compression frame and the exclusion of singular translated poles. It recovered 29 declarations. The combined selection contains 840 distinct declarations and 19 confirmed source-only names. The twenty-second inspection queried 36 new names for the character-line subtraction used in the geometric Galois construction, the local compatibility induction and its selected coefficient normalization. It recovered 34 declarations. The source theorem on unrestricted split-prime density is absent under its own name. The selected guarded-place argument takes the density of its designated places from a separate degree-one argument. One candidate belongs to a different namespace in the source and is excluded from the source-only list. The combined selection contains 874 distinct declarations and 20 confirmed source-only names. The twenty-third inspection queried 9 new names for the passage from good Frobenius classes to the comparison of even-rank representations at the guarded places. It recovered 9 declarations. The combined selection contains 883 distinct declarations and 20 confirmed source-only names. The twenty-fourth inspection queried 99 names for compact weight selection, the invariant Casimir cutoff, descent, and identification of the terminal type and recovered 93 declarations. Six source spellings are private. Their full export spellings are checked in the twenty-seventh selection. The twenty-fifth inspection queried 44 names for the two realizations of the terminal compact type and Frobenius on the permitted split places and recovered 44 declarations. The twenty-sixth inspection queried 40 names for orthogonality through the derivative layers, and the limiting construction and local properties of the odd-rank companion and recovered 40 declarations. The twenty-seventh inspection queried 6 names for the resolved module-qualified private constants used in the compact derivative and parameter calculations and recovered 6 declarations. The combined selection contains 1066 distinct declarations and 20 previously documented source-only names. The twenty-eighth inspection combined the derivative layer, positive tensor trace and geometric odd-rank seed in a single digest-checked scan. It recovered all 103 newly selected declarations, including the private opposite-sign counting lemma under its module-qualified name. The combined selection contains 1,169 distinct declarations and 20 previously documented source-only names. The twenty-ninth inspection traced the finite Hecke approximation, polynomial restriction and the holomorphic Lefschetz input. Both private approximation lemmas were queried under their module-qualified names. The 34 queries included two extra namespace candidates excluded after finding both declarations under their exact names. The scan recovered 32 newly selected declarations. The combined selection contains 1,201 distinct declarations and 20 previously documented source-only names. The thirtieth inspection followed the normalized ideal norm of a terminal minor through the product formula, the extended different and the height bound. The scan recovered 18 newly selected declarations. The combined selection contains 1,219 distinct declarations and 20 previously documented source-only names. Two further inspections traced the rank-extraction argument, the descent of fixed-weight moments and the nonvanishing of the terminal minor. Across 48 and 74 requests they located 117 additional declarations. One spelling candidate was resolved by reading the caller and selecting its exact exported name in the second scan. Three further complete selections examined the tangent-generated algebra, the component row, integral Hecke frames, genericity at fixed level away from one place, and the ordered-pair estimate for lists of minors. They added 239 distinct declarations. Ten source-attested names were absent under the exact queried spelling. The selected callers for the mathematical conclusions were checked independently. Five further inspections traced finite-group approximation, spherical detection, level counting, prescribed cuspidal types, weight variation and conjugate automorphic forms. The combined selection contains 1,904 distinct declarations and 35 source names absent from the export. Every selected declaration was read again at its recorded offset and all recorded value paths were checked. Six further complete inspections of the same digest-verified export traced the common level and twisted forms, the two-matrix family, its decomposition, the partial-sum inequalities, the circle weights, the projection onto one archimedean type, the weights and fixed vector at the other places, the geometric determinant character, and transport to the tower with its Hodge and congruence conditions. Across 164 requested names they added 163 declarations. The combined selection contains 2,067 distinct declarations and 36 source names absent from the export. All selected records were reread at their recorded offsets and the existing and new value paths were checked. Three further complete inspections of the same digest-verified export traced the auxiliary prime, the two roots over a split prime, the depth fixing a local vector, the integer and ideal levels, the spectral projector and power traces, the common geometric level, the choice of test places and the construction of the standard base datum of the tower. Across 228 requested names they added 217 declarations. The combined selection contains 2,284 distinct declarations and 44 source names absent from the export. All selected records were reread at their recorded offsets and the existing and new value paths were checked. Three further complete inspections of the same digest-verified export traced the generic moduli spaces, the isogenies and their descent, passage to fibre powers, smoothness and finite étale correspondences, simultaneous Hodge eigenclasses and the weighted holomorphic trace, and the integral covers used for good reduction and polynomial congruence, including restriction to an open and closed part. Across 270 requested names they added 267 declarations. The combined selection contains 2,551 distinct declarations and 47 source names absent from the export. All selected records were reread at their recorded offsets and the existing and new value paths were checked. Three further complete inspections of the same digest-verified export traced the integral sites and level comparisons, the finite étale cover and its splitting, the lifts of the Hecke correspondences and their fibre multiplicities, the ordinary point count, and the integral good-reduction and congruence witnesses. Across 419 requested names they added 414 declarations. The combined selection contains 2,965 distinct declarations and 52 source names absent from the export. All selected records were reread at their recorded offsets and the existing and new value paths were checked. Two further complete inspections of the same digest-verified export traced factorization through the ordinary generic point of the special fibre, the Kodaira–Spencer obstruction, the generic torsion space and its distinguished line, the two geometric cases, the Frobenius isogeny and the assembly on fibre powers. Across 275 requested names they added 272 declarations. Three references from earlier, unrelated results with the same short names were screened out. The combined selection contains 3,237 distinct declarations and 52 source names absent from the export. All selected records were reread at their recorded offsets and the existing and new value paths were checked. Three further complete inspections of the same digest-verified export traced the local length of the torsion scheme, the signature tangent line, the truncated local quotient, the lifted tangent, its Frobenius factorization, the Hodge filtration, the Verschiebung preimage and the separating residue-character eigenvector. Across 92 requested names the scans added 92 declarations. The combined selection contains 3,329 distinct declarations, and 52 source names remain absent from the export. The inspection reread every selected record at its byte offset and checked all recorded value paths. Two additional complete inspections of the digest-verified export traced the rank-two Kodaira–Spencer direction, the Hodge graph over the dual numbers, its isotropy and signature, lifting the abelian scheme, coefficient action, polarization and level, transport of the Frobenius-span inclusion, and uniqueness of the filtered lift modulo the Hodge subspace. Across 122 requested names the scans added 122 declarations. The combined selection contains 3,451 distinct declarations and 52 source names absent from the export. Every selected record was reread at its byte offset and every recorded value path was checked. Three additional complete inspections of the digest-verified export traced the construction of the place projector, the integral coefficients and their annihilator relations, the transfer to projective modules and dual cohomology, the auxiliary ideal and the degree of its complementary torsion subgroup, and the character and Frobenius multiplicity formulas. The paths attached to the numerical example identify the general results it illustrates. Across 111 requested names the scans added 109 declarations. The combined selection contains 3,560 distinct declarations and 54 source names absent from the export. Every selected record was reread at its byte offset and every recorded value path was checked. Three additional complete inspections of the digest-verified export traced the translation squares, lattice congruences and marked quotients, the two projections on the normal model, extension of the complementary homomorphisms, compatibility of the polarizing bundles and descent of the elementary correspondence. The paths attached to the Gaussian example identify the general results it illustrates. Across 116 requested names the scans added 108 declarations. The combined selection contains 3,668 distinct declarations and 54 source names absent from the export. Every selected record was reread at its byte offset and every recorded value path was checked. Two preliminary selections and one complete digest-verified inspection traced marked Hodge fixed points. The complete inspection independently reproduced both preliminary selections. The paths identify the torus lattice index, tangent weights, the marked orbit and its stabilizer, the level multiplicity, the root weights and interpolation, the two alternants, the marked-pair comparison and the definite Hecke trace. For the square torus example the paths identify the general counting and weighting formulas illustrated. The three reports added 216 declarations to the selection. It now contains 3,884 distinct declarations and 60 source names absent from the export. Every selected declaration was reread at its byte offset and every published value path was checked. Three independent complete reads of the uncompressed export checked the integral period lattice constructions. All three matched the original SHA-256. The value paths cover the finite coefficient field, the image lattice, translated-trace divisibility, thickened simultaneous auxiliary layers, the transition matrices and the local column decomposition and the filtration-adapted de Rham basis. The two-adic example points to the general theorems it illustrates. Its numerical checks are independent of the export. The three reports added 141 declarations. The cumulative selection contains 4,025 distinct declarations and 60 source names absent from the export. All selected byte offsets and all published value paths were rechecked.
